claims.claim_vi: With up to 3 retries and failure probability 0.5 per try the mean attempts per request is 1.875; with total failure it is 4; a chain of four services (three calling steps) each retrying 3 times gives 4x4x4 = 64 calls at the last one (three services, two steps: 4x4 = 16).
